title: Pauser can sandwich pause/unpause cycles to lock specific stakers into pauseWithdraw (forfeiting rewards) while others claim normally — selective denial of yield

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-6 'Pauser trust assumptions - designated pauser can pause/unpause contract operations'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-6 acknowledges the Pauser's raw power to pause/unpause. This finding sharpens it into a concrete economic exploitation of that power (selective denial-of-yield via cycling). On strict KI matching, the root cause IS the acknowledged trust assumption. Per 'when in doubt, keep' and the dedup note that this is 'likely demoted to QA / centralization-report'. Kept and flagged so severity-classifier can route to QA/centralization bundle rather than standalone Medium. Borderline.
